thumbnails.scene: The Geek sits on a sofa in warm evening lamp light with a fleece blanket over his lap, looking down with a deadpan, slightly pained expression. The silver tabby cat stands on his lap kneading the blanket with its white front paws, eyes half closed in bliss, ringed tail raised.

The Geek sits stiffly on a sofa in jeans with no blanket, gripping the cushion, lips pressed tight in a flat deadpan wince. The silver tabby cat stands on his thigh kneading his jeans, its claws visibly poking out of one white front paw into the denim, eyes half closed and calm.

The Geek sits on a sofa cradling the silver tabby cat against the front of his green hoodie, looking down at it with a puzzled deadpan expression. The cat kneads the hoodie fabric with both white front paws, eyes closed, purring contentedly, a corner of the hoodie in its mouth like a kitten nursing.

The silver tabby cat lies on its back on a soft blanket on the sofa, white paws raised and kneading the empty air, eyes half closed in a blissful daze. The Geek leans in beside it, staring at the cat's paws with a flat, baffled deadpan look.

The Geek lies back on a sofa holding a TV remote, looking down at his chest with a flat, suspicious deadpan expression. The silver tabby cat stands on his chest kneading his green hoodie with its white front paws and looking at him calmly and confidently, a few faint soft scent wisps drawn rising from under its paws.
